description: Tabular fraud competition. The hidden time structure caused a large public/private gap when contestants used random KFold. Winners used adversarial validation + temporal split.

competition_input.title: Fraud Detection (synthetic, hidden temporal structure)
competition_input.description: Detect fraudulent transactions in a synthetic banking dataset. Train contains 200k rows with anonymized features; test contains 100k rows. The dataset has a hidden temporal structure (transactions per quarter).

known_outcome.lesson: Winners ran adversarial validation first; some switched to temporal CV.
